sourceDocuments.title: Clinical Epidemiology of Hemoglobinopathies in Lagos State
sourceDocuments.text: Sickle cell anemia represents a major public health challenge across sub-Saharan Africa, with Nigeria recording the highest annual birth prevalence of homozygous hemoglobin S. Maintenance therapy with hydroxyurea increases fetal hemoglobin expression and significantly reduces painful vaso-occlusive crises.
